shapeSummary: U-channel with a 4 mm thick base, 48 mm long along X and 48 mm wide along Z. Two 4 mm thick flanges rise along the long edges to a total height of 16 mm. Each flange has 5 through holes of 4 mm diameter on an 8 mm pitch, and the base has a central 14 mm through hole.
warnings: Only the 48 mm length is given. Width (48 mm), height (16 mm) and wall thickness (4 mm) are estimates.
The flange hole diameter (4 mm) and height (10 mm) are estimated.
The central hole diameter (14 mm) is estimated.
The smaller holes around the central hole in the base are visible, but their positions and sizes are uncertain, so they are omitted.
Countersinks or chamfers on the holes are not modeled.
cadquery:
outer = cq.Workplane('XY').box(48, 16, 48, centered=(True, False, True))
inner = cq.Workplane('XY').box(48, 12, 40, centered=(True, False, True)).translate((0, 4, 0))
part = outer.cut(inner)
flange_holes = cq.Workplane('XY').pushPoints([(x, 10) for x in (-16, -8, 0, 8, 16)]).circle(2).extrude(30, both=True)
part = part.cut(flange_holes)
center_hole = cq.Workplane('XZ').circle(7).extrude(10, both=True)
part = part.cut(center_hole)
